name: hud_ui_message_update_selected_weapon_display
description: HudUiMessage::UpdateSelectedWeaponDisplay updates weapon-message selection images, active side ownership, selected value text, and active weapon-message state.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native selected-weapon HUD message tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x412820 validates restoring the previously active message selection for banks above one, storing the new active message and side, selecting the highlighted variant side+3 when the value is positive, handling bank one through message slot one, clearing active selection for nonpositive banks, updating text only when the requested side matches the message active side, using the special clear-token string for value 123456792.0, otherwise writing ceil(value) with "%d", and invalidating the message base after numeric writes.

The native selected-weapon smoke verifies previous selection restoration, highlighted variant selection, side-image swap ownership, active selection globals, numeric text update, special clear-token update, and active-selection clearing.
